children: Overview
US waste services provider's Q3 revenue slightly beat analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 missed analyst expectations
Company returned $957 mln to shareholders via buybacks and dividends in Q3
Outlook
WM expects 2026 revenue at high end of $26.275-$26.475 bln guidance
Company sees 2026 adj operating EBITDA within $8.15-$8.25 bln guidance
WM expects 2026 free cash flow at high end of $3.75-$3.85 bln guidance
Result Drivers
PRICING AND SURCHARGES - Co said Q3 revenue growth was driven by higher pricing, energy surcharges and increased recycling and renewable energy volumes
HEALTHCARE SOLUTIONS - Co said Healthcare Solutions segment saw higher revenue and operating income due to cost management, synergies and pricing
OPERATING EFFICIENCY OFFSET - Co said Collection and Disposal efficiency improved, but higher fuel and risk management costs offset margin gains
